CiA page confirms FDF, BRS, ESI, 17-bit CRC up to 16 bytes and fixed stuff bits; the BRS bit switches at its sample point, so the true frame is longer and the bound holds.

No transceiver row exists, so 5 ms is the page's gate budget taken by analogy, stated as such.

DroneCAN 4.4: 'DroneCAN operates on CANFD', 'frames can be up to 64 bytes in length'; 4.1 is the classic transport. README.md:110 and STATUS.md:383 name DroneCAN as a protocol whose reference code is read for confirmation; the tree states no protocol for the port, so CAN FD (a superset that carries classic CAN) is an inference, stated as such.

DroneCAN section 8 table: 1000 kbit/s the highest recommended rate; 4.4: nominal 1 MBps 'with payload switching to 1, 2, 4, 5 or 8 MBit depending on hardware capabilities'. SLLSFS8A page 1: CAN FD 'networks up to 5 megabits per second (Mbps). Up to 8 Mbps operation in simpler networks'. 5000 kbit/s is a choice limited by that transceiver, not the primary source's highest (8 MBit); TCAN1472-Q1 states 8 Mbps incl. SIC and MCP2518FD BRDATA to 8 Mbps, so the ranked parts also carry 8 Mbit/s. Earlier P4 runs (FU-A1, FU-A2, T2) confirmed it on the same reading.

DroneCAN section 8 CAN bus parameters, 1000 kbit/s row: sample point valid 75% to 90%, recommended 87.5%, max bus length 40 m, max stub length 0.3 m; note: 'propagation delay does not exceed 5 ns/m, not including additional delay times of CAN transceivers and other components'.

D-Sub: CAN Ground (pin 3) 'Must be interconnected with Ground (pin 6) within the device'; Micro connector circuit 4 Ground; the device ground is the bus ground, so not isolated, 0 V. IOBoard.md names isolation only for the cell monitor (line 474), none for the CAN port.

D-Sub and M8: 'Devices that deliver power to the bus are required to provide 23.0-30.0 V on the bus power line, 24 V nominal', beside CAN High and CAN Low; Micro: 5.0-5.5 V. The port's connector is a round 2 choice, so the highest, 30.0 V, is taken. Ranked transceiver: TCAN1472 VBUS -58 to 58 V.

IOBoard.md Link cable row: the cable carries the display's supply; Display supply voltage 5 V (F6) from the 5 V rail, tolerance open (V100). DroneCAN Micro: 'required to provide 5.0-5.5 V on the bus power line'; 5.5 V taken by analogy. SN65HVD233 -36 to 36 V, TCAN3413 and TCAN1472 -58 to 58 V, all above 36 V.
